rows.what_the_ink_shows: At the end of “diviseurs premiers de”, the manuscript has a low, nearly horizontal cursive n with a short initial upturn, followed by a period; see crops/14_scan063_L261_diviseurs.jpg. It lacks the tall angular uprights of the unmistakable capital N after “cardinal” (crops/14_scan063_L261_cardinal_N.jpg) and in N^{-r}D_0 (crops/14_scan063_L261_N_power.jpg). Thus the existing lowercase n is faithful to the ink.
rows.note: Written: “tous les diviseurs premiers de n”. Intended, according to the supplied correction and the local introduction of N as the cardinal of Ker u: “tous les diviseurs premiers de N”. Preserve lowercase n as the author’s case/notation slip; the proposed capital N belongs in the note, not in a silent diplomatic correction.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Visually collated the assigned full scan and three enlarged, contrast-raised crops. Compared the terminal lowercase n with the capital N in the same paragraph and identified the local kernel-order notation. No proof of the denominator or prime-divisor assertion was checked.
